metadata.description: Registry for the skill disambiguation experiment. Contains two unit-conversion plugins with identically named skills that differ in default unit system behavior.

plugins.description: Unit conversion plugin operating in metric (SI) mode. Assumes ambiguous inputs are imperial and converts to metric.
plugins.name: metric-converter

plugins.description: Unit conversion plugin operating in imperial mode. Assumes ambiguous inputs are metric and converts to imperial.
plugins.name: imperial-converter
